claims.statement: WHO frames GLP-1 treatment as long-term, comprehensive care with structured diet and physical activity, and EMA describes prescription, weekly use, dose escalation, and weight-management context. A private clinic can therefore be asked to embed baseline and monthly strength/function measurements at initiation; workflow access is not yet secured.

The measurable risk is deterioration in lean mass or function during rapid pharmacologic weight loss. In the SURMOUNT-1 DXA substudy, about one quarter of lost weight was lean mass, but that does not establish clinically harmful muscle loss for every patient and must not be turned into a diagnostic claim.

The payer hypothesis is a private obesity clinic funding per-patient monitoring from its multidisciplinary program revenue at drug initiation and follow-up, or passing the fee to a self-pay patient. WHO and NICE support comprehensive specialist care, but neither source proves a Polish clinic budget for this specific module.

contrary_evidence: The prospective SEMALEAN study reported initially reduced then stabilized lean mass and improved handgrip strength, so universal deterioration is contradicted.
Clinics may view simple strength and body-composition measures as undifferentiated services they can perform themselves.

economics.acquisition_route: Co-design a non-diagnostic monitoring protocol with one obesity physician and physiotherapist, enroll 20 clinic patients at initiation, and test whether functional feedback improves adherence or clinic retention before building software.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: If clinics adopt a standardized function-preservation outcome bundle, longitudinal response data and remote coaching can support a scalable clinic network product; the founder objective requires B2B distribution beyond direct coaching hours.
economics.founder_time: About 10-15 hours per week for product, analysis, and partner coordination; clinicians supervise treatment and contracted coaches deliver patient contact.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Software, protocol, and group coaching margin after devices, clinician review, and coach time; no drug margin or medical treatment revenue is assumed.
economics.payback: Recover devices and protocol setup within the first 20-30 paid patient episodes, with no custom app until renewal is demonstrated.
economics.pricing: Clinic license plus per-patient 6- or 12-month monitoring episode; optional patient-paid premium tier with supervised exercise partner.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Patients are monitored monthly over long treatment; clinics renew as new cohorts start and aggregate outcomes become useful.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Longitudinal clinic-linked treatment, strength, composition, adherence, and functional-outcome data
fingerprint.customer: Private obesity and metabolic clinics managing adults on GLP-1 therapies
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Physician, dietitian, and physiotherapy clinic partnerships at prescription initiation
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Non-diagnostic functional monitoring protocol and remote support licensed to clinics per enrolled patient
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Clinic or self-pay patient pays when GLP-1 therapy begins and renews during long-term follow-up
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A patient begins substantial medication-assisted weight loss without a tracked baseline for function and lean tissue

founder_fit: The opportunity combines quantified-self interest, fitness familiarity, health data, and analytical product design.
Medical decisions remain with physician partners, while the founder focuses on measurement and systems.
A small clinic pilot can validate demand without a personal influencer brand or heavy capital.
risks: Poor messaging could medicalize normal body-composition change or create unsupported health claims.
Clinic workflows and patient adherence may make monthly data incomplete.
Body-composition devices can be noisy, and DXA is too expensive for frequent routine use.

structure.control_point: The baseline and recurring functional measurement protocol embedded at prescription initiation
structure.critical_dependency: A physician-approved, affordable measurement bundle that changes clinic or patient decisions without making unsupported claims

thesis: Backcast from obesity care being judged on durable function rather than kilograms alone: win the treatment-initiation measurement moment now, then compound clinic-linked response data into the functional outcome layer for long-term GLP-1 care.
title: GLP-1 Functional Reserve
uncertainties: The prevalence of clinically meaningful functional decline in the intended patient segment is uncertain and may be low.
No Polish clinic has confirmed willingness to pay or pass through the fee.
It is unknown whether tracked function improves adherence, outcomes, or clinic retention enough to justify the program.
